title: POST /auth/login – 200 response
description: A Sanctum token with the supervisor ability, returned only once. It has no fixed expiry, but the server may refuse it (401 unauthenticated) after a period without use (laravel-waypost: waypost.token_idle_days, 90 days by default); the app then asks for the password again. Wrong credentials: 401 unauthenticated. Error responses use api/error.json.

token.description: Bearer token for the Authorization header. Opaque; store it in the secure store.
